My verdict is **PASS** on candidate `sha256:69b7412a…0e86` (1472 files, source `3e3a06e`). The candidate ID matched on a complete clone and on the main tree, at the start and at the end. Both of my round-4 findings are fixed, and I raised one new Low finding that does not block the gate.

**My round-4 findings** (both now CLOSED_VERIFIED; tested on the real stack, in EN and AR, with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8)

- **F-DG4-143 (Medium): fixed.**
  - In my round-4 world (a non-cash benefit planned only in 2099), that line now reads "Not applicable (n/a)" with its reason, on both T10 and the Executive Overview. It never shows Unknown, a number or green.
  - I also built a world with a genuinely missing amount. That line reads "Unknown: a value amount is missing", never "Not applicable".
  - The other value lines read 100 % Red, as before.
- **F-DG4-144 (Low): fixed.**
  - My round-4 probe now passes unchanged.
  - A new probe tried every remedy the note names, on the Executive Overview, Finance and adoption dashboards, in a business unit of 54 transformations:
    - Narrowing by phase or by status requests exactly the matching transformations.
    - The transformation filter reaches a transformation beyond the first 51.
    - A narrowing that matches nothing shows the new "none matching" note.
    - A transformation from another unit is never requested.
    - The 50-transformation limit still holds.

**Full review of this candidate**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Static (7 checks) | All exit 0; 652 API operations |
| Integration, run twice (61 migrations, contract test included) | 1975/1975 each time; every pending list empty |
| `tests/qa` alone | 172/172 |
| REQ-DLV-036 (A04, A09, A10, A11) | 85/85, plus the A04/A08/A09 e2e specs in both browser projects |
| Full e2e, locale unset | 352 passed, 5 failed, 7 did not run |
| Full e2e, C.UTF-8 | 360 passed, 1 failed, 3 did not run |
| Failing specs re-run alone | 74/74 with locale unset and 74/74 with C.UTF-8 |
| `pnpm test` (Node 22 and 24, both locales) | All four pass at lower load; the first four runs failed (F-DG4-145) |
| Validator (register, pipeline, historical DG3/DG2/DG1) | All pass |
| Requirement trace | 137/137 rows covered; the partial-coverage disclosures are still acceptable |

**Failures in the evidence, all explained**

- **e2e:** every failure was a 30 s test timeout. Three reviews were running at once (load average 9–19). Every one of those specs passed when re-run alone.
- **My own probe:** one check failed in two C.UTF-8 runs. A diagnostic showed the page always renders its heading together with the no-permission state (24 out of 24 attempts). My check code treated both being present as an error. I fixed that in my probe and re-ran it: 0 failures in both locales.

**New finding**

- **F-DG4-145 (Low, not mandatory, owner frontend-ux-engineer):** a DG2 unit test (`session-bound.test.tsx`, "Y1c", English) makes `pnpm test` fail whenever the machine is busy.
  - It failed in all four of my `pnpm test` runs at load 13–15.
  - When I forced CPU contention on the test file alone, it failed 2/2 on this candidate and 2/2 on the round-4 source.
  - It passes alone and in all four runs at lower load.
  - **Cause:** the test counts identity checks (`GET /me`) using real time. The product correctly re-checks identity after its 2-second window, so under load an extra check appears and the exact count fails.
  - This is a pre-existing fault in the test, not a regression and not a product defect. D-118 had recorded it once before.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/reviews/DG4/round-5/`: the record `qa-verifier.json`, `qa-verifier.verifications.json`, `qa-verifier.findings.json` and the narrative `qa-verifier.md`. The evidence and a run-by-run account are under `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/round-5/`, starting with `RUN-NOTES.md`. My test probes are outside the candidate, in `docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG4/qa/tests/round-5/`. I removed the disposable clones afterwards.
